QuestInfo.name: Chief Stan's Signature
QuestInfo.0: #b#p202##k asked me to speak to him again about the pages I retrieved for #b#p326##k.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p202##k made out one word in the damaged pages. He sent me to #b#p502##k in #b#m010004000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p502##k recognized the handwriting and remembered part of the entry. He asked me to speak with him again once I was ready.

0.0: I got one word off the top page before the ink ran. One! Warrior.
0.1: There was a novice who came through here years ago, green as grass, telling anyone who'd listen about becoming a warrior. Half the beginners in this town say it.
0.2: Then this rookie stopped coming around. I assumed this traveler had gone to #b#m010004000##k to make something of themselves, the way they all do.
0.3: ...I never asked after them. Not once. I'm the elder of this town and I never asked.
0.4: Go to #b#p502##k. Every amateur who wants a real weapon ends up in front of that man sooner or later. Will you take it?

yes.0: Good. He's not much of a talker, but he may perk up once he sees where that ledger came from.

no.0: Then leave it here! It's waited this long, it can wait for someone with a spine.

1.1: I know this handwriting. I put my mark on a page written in it once, in a small room above the #b#m010002003##k. I never went back up there. So she's still writing...
1.2: Stan's stamp. So, he sent an adventurer up here for something he couldn't read himself. Typical.
1.3: There was another one like you once. Stood right about there. Talked at me for a month about a sword they were saving for.
1.4: Ten thousand short, this fool would say. As if I cared. \nI told them the truth. Nobody buys their first real weapon. You inherit one, or you take it off something that tried to kill you.
1.5: Then I told the rookie to get out of my sight. \n...And they did.
1.6: The pages are too damaged, but I know who may be able to help.

npc.0: Please bring the book to #b#p502##k. I'm sure he'll know where to go next.

item.0: What do you want? Come back when you have something useful.

lost.0: Did you lose the book I gave you? Sigh... Lucky for you I have an extra, but please be careful not to lose it this time.
